name: prism-host
title: Prism Host
purpose: Decides how the owner's browser uses each surface it reports as a route for the owner's own content, so that every surface the browser exposes is used, nothing is used while the Prism is halted, nothing the owner holds is read without the owner's act or a grant the browser keeps, and a live account on another origin is named sealed instead of reached around.

fields.name: surface
fields.means: the browser surface: a granted folder, picked files, dropped files, a paste, the contact picker, the device's cores and memory, or a live mail or calendar account on another origin

fields.name: present
fields.means: whether this browser reports the surface

fields.name: act
fields.means: whether the owner's own press, pick, drop or paste is this use

fields.name: grant
fields.means: whether the browser keeps the owner's grant for this surface across visits

fields.name: halted
fields.means: whether the owner has pressed the kill switch

rules.says: when halted is yes then refuse
when surface is mail then sealed
rules.why: a live mail account on another origin is closed to every page by the same-origin policy

rules.says: when surface is calendar then sealed
rules.why: a live calendar on another origin is closed to every page by the same-origin policy

rules.says: when present is no then refuse
rules.why: a surface the browser does not report is never offered

rules.says: when surface is workers then use
rules.why: the device's cores and memory read nothing of the owner's, so they are always used

rules.says: when act is owner then use
rules.why: the owner's own act is the consent for this use

rules.says: when surface is folder and grant is kept then use
rules.why: a folder the owner granted is re-read while the browser keeps the grant

properties.says: always when halted is yes then refuse
properties.why: when the owner presses the kill switch no surface is used (constitution P7)

properties.says: never when surface is mail then use
properties.why: the Prism never reaches around the browser's seal on another origin

properties.says: never when surface is calendar then use
properties.why: the Prism never reaches around the browser's seal on another origin

properties.says: never when present is no then use
properties.why: a surface the browser does not report is never used

properties.says: never when present is no then offer
properties.why: a surface the browser does not report is never shown

properties.says: never when act is none and grant is none and surface is folder then use
properties.why: no folder is read without the owner's act or a kept grant

properties.says: never when act is none and surface is contacts then use
properties.why: contacts are read only when the owner picks them

properties.says: never when act is none and surface is paste then use
properties.why: the clipboard is read only on the owner's paste

properties.says: never when act is none and surface is files then use
properties.why: files are read only when the owner picks them

properties.says: never when act is none and surface is drop then use
properties.why: dropped files are read only when the owner drops them

meanings.use: the page uses the surface now
meanings.offer: the page shows the surface's control and waits for the owner
meanings.sealed: the browser seals it from every page on another origin

otherwiseWhy: every surface the browser reports is offered to the owner
limits: It does not read anything itself: each item still goes through PrismFolder, the router, the Boundary and the vault.
Sharing to the Prism and opening files with it need the app manifest and service worker, which the locked frame generates without a hook.
The worker count is the host rule uorc states: at most one per core, sixteen, and two per GiB the browser reports.
